faqs.question: Is the Kelty Internal Frame Backpack true to size?
faqs.answer: Most buyers report a true-to-size fit. If you wear thick cushioned hiking socks or custom orthotics, order a half size up.

faqs.question: How does it perform in sustained rain?
faqs.answer: In our 60-minute submersion protocol the 420D nylon with DWR coating showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.
